## 2. Core Service Offerings & Engineering Stack

### Pillar 1: High-Converting Web & Full-Stack Product Engineering
- **Backend Architecture:** Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis caching, JWT auth, and secure role-based access control.
- **Frontend Architecture:** React 18, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, pre-rendered static generation (SSG), and edge CDN caching for sub-0.8s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
- **Payment & Checkout Integrations:** 1-Click instant checkout replacing multi-step cart friction. Integrates Stripe, PayPal, LemonSqueezy, bKash, Nagad, and SSLCommerz.
- **Logistics & Courier Webhooks:** Automated order dispatch to Steadfast, Pathao, RedX, and international courier APIs.

### Pillar 2: Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals Domination
- **100/100 Google PageSpeed Score:** Sub-0.8s load times, zero render-blocking scripts, and WebP/AVIF image pipeline.
- **Programmatic Schema.org JSON-LD:** Structured data for Organization, ProfessionalService, Product, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, and BlogPosting.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):** Optimized for citation in AI Search engines including ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Google AI Overviews, and Claude.
- **Server-Side Tracking:** Server-Side Meta Conversion API (CAPI) and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) bypassing iOS 14.5 ad blockers.

### Pillar 3: Autonomous RAG AI Agents & Workflow Automation
- **Vector RAG Customer Support & Sales Agents:** 24/7 AI assistants deployed to WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Discord, and Website chat. Trained strictly on verified company catalogs, SOPs, or whitepapers with zero hallucination.
- **OpenClaw Business Automation:** Local/server-hosted AI agents automating deep B2B lead generation, competitor scraping, and CRM synchronization without per-request subscription markups.

## 3. Flagship Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Edel Bangladesh (Luxury 1-Click Storefront)
- **Live Demo:** [https://cryptowebbuild.github.io/edel-bangladesh/](https://cryptowebbuild.github.io/edel-bangladesh/)
- **Case Study URL:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/auracommerce](https://cryptowebbuild.com/auracommerce)
- **Category:** Luxury Bridal Jewelry & Churi (facebook.com/edelbangladesh)
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, 1-Click bKash/COD, Steadfast Courier API, Meta CAPI
- **Key Results:**
  - 0.4s load time on mobile 4G networks.
  - Eliminated manual "Inbox for Price" drop-offs.
  - +240% increase in mobile order conversion.

### 2. ShopFast Headless Storefront
- **Live URL:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/shopfast](https://cryptowebbuild.com/shopfast)
- **Category:** Headless Commerce
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, Stripe / 1-Click Cart, 100/100 Core Web Vitals
- **Key Results:** 0.4s LCP, +216% checkout completion lift over legacy WooCommerce.

### 3. ClickRunClaw (Flagship AI SaaS Engine)
- **Live URL:** [https://clickrunclaw.com/](https://clickrunclaw.com/)
- **Category:** Managed AI Cloud Runtime
- **Description:** Managed 24/7 cloud infrastructure for autonomous OpenClaw & RAG AI agents with 1-click webhook provisioning for WhatsApp, Discord, and Telegram.

### 4. Vanguard B2B Financial SaaS
- **Live URL:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/vanguardsaas](https://cryptowebbuild.com/vanguardsaas)
- **Category:** Python / Django B2B Analytics
- **Tech Stack:** Python, Django REST, PostgreSQL, React, D3.js
- **Key Results:** Sub-50ms query responses on tables querying 10M+ financial records.

### 5. AutoGit Edge Deployer
- **Live URL:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/autogithub](https://cryptowebbuild.com/autogithub)
- **Category:** Browser DevOps SaaS
- **Description:** Client-side DevOps engine allowing developers to deploy repositories directly from the browser via GitHub REST API.

### 6. SolNova & Nexus Web3 Protocols
- **Live URLs:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/tokenlaunch](https://cryptowebbuild.com/tokenlaunch), [https://cryptowebbuild.com/nexusweb3](https://cryptowebbuild.com/nexusweb3)
- **Tech Stack:** React, Solana Web3.js, Ethers.js, Phantom/Solflare wallet bridge, live RPC telemetry.
